blocks.text: UNITED STATES SECURITIES AND EXCHANGE COMMISSION Washington, D.C. 20549 FORM 10-K ANNUAL REPORT PURSUANT TO SECTION 13 OR 15(d) OF THE SECURITIES EXCHANGE ACT OF 1934 For the fiscal year ended September 30, 2024 Northwind Systems, Inc. (Exact name of registrant as specified in its charter) Trading Symbol: NWSY Securities registered pursuant to Section 12(b) of the Act: Common Stock, $0.001 par value.

Management's Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations. Total net sales increased to $4,812.6 million in fiscal 2024 from $4,301.9 million in fiscal 2023, an increase of 11.9%. The increase was driven by continued expansion of our subscription platform and record renewal rates across enterprise accounts. Gross profit improved to $3,166.8 million, reflecting a favorable shift in product mix toward higher-margin software offerings. Operating income was $962.5 million compared with $774.3 million in the prior year.

Net income for fiscal 2024 was $731.4 million, an increase from $588.2 million in fiscal 2023. Cash generated by operating activities was $1,104.2 million, and we invested $268.4 million in property and equipment during the year. We ended the year with total debt of $1,180.0 million against shareholders' equity of $2,455.7 million. Management believes the balance sheet remains well positioned to fund continued investment in research and development.

Item 1A. Risk Factors. Our business is subject to risks and uncertainties. Intense competition in the enterprise software market could adversely affect our pricing and our ability to retain customers. If we are unable to keep pace with rapid technological change, our results of operations could be materially and adversely affected.

We derive a significant portion of our revenue from a limited number of large customers, and the loss of one or more of them could materially reduce our net sales. Our international operations expose us to currency fluctuations that may adversely affect reported results. We may not be able to protect our intellectual property adequately, and litigation to defend it could be costly and time consuming.

Cybersecurity incidents present a significant risk to our operations. A material breach of our systems could result in loss of customer data, regulatory penalties and reputational harm, and could have a material adverse effect on our business, financial condition and results of operations.
